title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles — Episode2 Valentine's Day Worries

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Event Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, guess what?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's almost...Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. It's that time of year already...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, and the mall's supposed to be having a Valentine's Day fair. I might go check it out to see if they have anything cute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, why is Valentine's Day such a big deal...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! You're kidding, right?!
Valentine's Day is a huge event that involves lots of activities! Like giving chocolates to your friends!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Giving chocolates to your friends...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um... Valentine's Day is all about showing appreciation for close acquaintances and the people you care about most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why you give chocolates to all your friends!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, it doesn't have to be chocolates. Anything is okay as long as it symbolizes your appreciation for whomever receives your gift♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
That's really nice. You have a whole day dedicated to giving gifts to each other.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right?! That's why it's such a great event!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I say the four of us celebrate Valentine's Day by...giving gifts to Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we should do something for them because they're always there for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I agree...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you wanna do, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know what to give, but I'll try looking for something...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you. We really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Then, don't forget to bring all your gifts on the day of!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Giving gifts to everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want Miku and the others to feel happy... And since we're doing this, I'd like to give something to Mizuki, Ena and Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But what should I get for them...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to Valentine's Day now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I wish I could do something like Mizuki and the others...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Len, did you say something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... N-No, it's nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone. Get ready for a really amazing Valentine's Day!
A few days later
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm starting to get hungry...
I should probably have something to eat...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Where did I put the instant noodles...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. Ms. Mochizuki's supposed to come over today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And she's going to be here soon. In that case, I'll wait until she arrives...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's subtle, but Ms. Mochizuki's smile always seems to fade whenever she sees so many instant noodle containers in the garbage...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I can use this time to look at some of the comments for the video we just uploaded. That shouldn't take up too much of my energy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, this banner ad...
It's for Valentine's Day...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: “Chocolates for that special someone”...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, I still haven't decided what I'm going to give everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Mizuki's going to bring some homemade sweets. But I can't do anything like that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that must be Ms. Mochizuki.
I need to go let her in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Ms. Yoisaki. Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Of course. It's always nice having you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Have you already had lunch?
If not, I can make something while I prepare your other meals.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th-Thank you. I was actually just getting a little hungry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay. Then, I'll get started right way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For lunch, I'll be making stewed udon. It's been very cold lately, so I hope it'll help warm you up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm looking forward to having it.
se_event_candle_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Ms. Mochizuki's so efficient...
Everything seems second nature to her and she doesn't waste any time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Not only that, the dishes she makes are all delicious. She really is a talented cook...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She can even bake her own apple pies. If she can handle something that difficult, then Valentine's Day should be...)
se_event_candle_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can I help you? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, um... Sorry, I didn't mean to get in the way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's just... You usually go straight back up to your room, so I began wondering if there was something you wanted to ask me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's not anything serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... If you don't mind listening for a second...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A gift for Valentine's Day...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's something that came up with my group the other day, and I was thinking about what to bring.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I briefly considered homemade sweets, but I don't know how to make anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I owe them all quite a lot, so I'd like to take this opportunity to properly thank them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. And that's why you seemed preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't realize that you were also in the same predicament...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Also...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. The truth is, Ichika asked me for some advice regarding this very subject just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hoshino did...?
Is she also planning on making something?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she'd already whittled her options down to jewelry or other accessories, but I gave her a few other ideas to go along with that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Accessories? I see. Yes, that is an option...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It is. However, I believe a Valentine's Day gift can take any shape as long as it symbolizes your appreciation for the person receiving it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree with you there.
So, what did you suggest that she make?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I gave her a few suggestions, but she ended up going with scented candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Scented candles...? You can make those yourself? I'm not sure I could...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's not true. Anyone can make them as long as they have all the necessary ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, actually. Ms. Yoisaki, if you'd like...
